export_controls.text: I want to be clear. This administration will block such efforts, full stop. We will safeguard American AI and chip technologies from theft and misuse, work with our allies and partners to strengthen and extend these protections,
export_controls.context: Vice President’s Paris AI Action Summit speech, immediately after describing foreign adversaries’ military and surveillance use of stolen AI.

attribution.speaker: JD Vance
attribution.note: Official transcript reproduced by the American Presidency Project.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says the administration will block efforts to steal or misuse American AI and chip technologies and will work with allies to extend protections.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly endorses blocking technology theft and coordinating protections with allies.
